suggestions.title: Gardening advice
suggestions.description: A practical guide to one gardening technique, task or season, explaining what to do and why, drawing on the studio's own practice.
suggestions.why: Five entries (mulch, pruning, winter structure, rain gardens, October jobs) open by naming a technique or season and promise to explain how and when to do it.

suggestions.title: Project case study
suggestions.description: A write-up of one garden or landscape the studio designed, describing the site, its constraints and how the design responded, sometimes revisited years later.
suggestions.why: Four entries are titled after a specific place (Tyne Valley hillside, Gateshead playground, Calder Street courtyard, Hexham walled garden) and open with the site's particular conditions.

suggestions.title: Studio news
suggestions.description: A short announcement about Northfold itself, such as a move to new premises or a new member of the team.
suggestions.why: Two entries (the move to Wharf Lane and Priya's arrival) announce changes at the studio, each opening with a one-line summary of the news.
